name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Account Manager role. Owning a customer from onboarding through renewal, and making sure they actually use what they bought, is the work I'm strongest at and the work I want to keep doing.

At Birdeye I managed 15 to 20 reseller partners with deals from $10K to $45K and retained all but one, roughly 94%, by watching utilization data for adoption gaps and stepping in before they became churn. At Wix I held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding 25+ clients a month. In my own practice I build automated re-engagement workflows that bring inactive customers back, which is the customer-advocate piece of your posting done systematically instead of one email at a time.

I haven't worked in logistics directly, but I've touched the shipping side of my customers' businesses. At Wix I helped retail clients launching e-commerce stores set up their third-party shipping integrations, so I've seen how much of a customer's experience rides on what happens after the order. What carries over most is how I learn a customer's operation: at Accelo I sold and scoped software for agencies, architecture firms, and engineering firms by learning how each one actually ran. Tive's value shows up in the data, and that's the conversation I like having at renewal. I'd welcome a conversation.
